channel.description: Latest articles from The Asian Age (asianage.com)

item.title: AA Edit | Iran Must Stop Ccrackdown
item.description: A regime that last year executed more than 2,000 people, many of them demonstrators who had joined rioters on the streets, seems determined to use the full might of the state to quell a popular uprising that is bigger than anything Iran may have seen in recent years

item.title: AA Edit | Honour Somnath Lesson, Stand United As Indians
item.description: The repeated attacks on the Somnath temple in Gujarat that began 1,000 years ago offer valuable lessons for India in that unity of purpose of the people is the best guarantee against a powerful enemy who may attempt an invasion from outside the border

item.title: Bharat Bhushan | Round One To Mamata In Poll-eve Tussle In Bengal
item.description: The timing is significant -- just weeks before the West Bengal state Assembly elections, which the BJP is desperate to win. No wonder then that Ms Banerjee has led a protest rally, filed complaints with the police, challenged the raids in the Calcutta high court and announced plans to gherao the Election Commission office for alleged voter list manipulation.

item.title: Kamal Davar | Dhaka Forgets Its Own History Amid Friction, Reset Of Ties Vitally Needed
item.description: That the instability in Bangladesh, after Seikh Hasina’s ouster in August 202, impacts India adversely can’t be underplayed

item.title: How to Plan Your Finances for 2026 and Use Credit Cards to Optimise Spending
item.description: IDFC FIRST Bank has a range of cards catering to multiple financial profiles. Knowing how each card rewards your spending helps you plan smarter, not harder, for 2026

item.description: There might still be some way to go before India and the USA sign the much-vaunted trade deal, but its new envoy Sergio Gor, who took office on Monday in New Delhi, was brimming with positivity about ties

item.title: AA Edit | Isro Must Probe PSLV Failure
item.description: The failure of the launch will delay the country’s ability to get another eye in the sky through hyperspectral remote sensing captures. It will also disappoint young space enthusiasts from Blue Blocks Montessori School, Hyderabad, and Laxman Gyanpith School, Ahmedabad

item.title: Shikha Mukrjee | Mamata, ED, I-PAC: A Masterclass In Politics
item.description: I-PAC is not just India’s largest political consultancy company. It is the Trinamul Congress’s data and strategy backbone and backroom; it has, according to Mamata Banerjee, sensitive and confidential information on her party’s organisation, potential candidates for the forthcoming election

item.title: Aakar Patel | Much To Admire About America, But There’s Also Lot To Dislike Too
item.description: The child goes to the best state institutions, subsidised by Indians, only to then in their 20s move permanently to the United States. American corporations like Microsoft, Google and Tesla and its universities benefit from the value added by such individuals from abroad to their workforce
